title: Residential Electricity Supply Loyalty Credits: Referral Loyalty Bonus
content:
**Rule.** When the renewing Residential Electricity Supply agreement carries two or more referral credit lines the multi-referral loyalty bonus of 15.00 USD is added to the renewal loyalty credit, when it carries exactly one the single-referral loyalty bonus of 10.00 USD is added, and when it carries none nothing is added.

**Lines counted.** Every referral credit line on that agreement's bills, whenever posted. Referral credits on the customer's other agreements are not counted.

| Referral credit lines on the agreement | Referral loyalty bonus |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 15.00 USD |
| exactly 1 | 10.00 USD |
| none | nothing |

**Example (hypothetical).** An agreement carrying referral credit lines for two different referred neighbours adds 15.00 USD.
